bullets.text: Nothing Ear (3) Missed Potential - **Nothing**'s latest earbuds offer rich sound but fall short on ANC performance.
iPhone 17 Pro Max Battery Champion - The **iPhone 17 Pro Max** outlasts the **Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra** in battery tests.
CMF Brand Spin-off - **Nothing** launches its budget brand **CMF** as a standalone subsidiary in India.
Google Cloud's AI Strategy - **Google Cloud** aims to capture AI startups with significant revenue commitments.
Waymo's Corporate Travel Service - **Waymo** launches a new service for businesses to access robotaxis for employees.
Neon App's Controversial Data Model - **Neon**, a top social app, pays users to record calls and sells data to AI firms.
Cohere's Valuation Surge - **Cohere** reaches a $7 billion valuation after raising $100 million and partnering with **AMD**.
YouTube Enhances User Control - **YouTube** now allows users to hide end screen recommendations at the end of videos.
